title: 🔧 Volta upgraded itself: state commits no longer lose whole runs
body: The first prop search (20 Oct, 2.5 h) was lost: learn-post had deleted announce.json while the search was running, and the commit step stopped on that one-file conflict. .github/actions_common.sh now settles such conflicts (keeps this run's copy, never deletes upstream data) and retries cleanly. Checked in a local git simulation of the exact failure. Undo: git revert 649a1fe

title: 🎁 Wish granted: Correct the prop search for luck (multiple-testing control)
body: Every validated prop-search candidate now gets 2 no-edge twins on its own 2022-23 days (random entry minute; same minute with a coin-flip side), same stop/target/plan/sizing. Per market a LUCK BAR = the EV the best of K such no-edge strategies reaches with 95% probability (K = validated tries). The leaderboard ranks by EV above the bar (BEATS LUCK / luck-level), and mutations, the nightly exam slots and the market focus use only luck-beaters once a bar exists (30+ placebos per market). See the LUCK BAR line in /search. Undo: git revert cdfcadb
